after: selftest-plan.json run 'full' failed udp_exactly_once_in_order while the oracle passed and the eth0 egress capture was in send order
purpose: diagnostic only: locate where UDP order is lost after eth0 egress; not a qualification and not a rerun of the failed full
run: veth_order_trace.sh order-trace --mode full (default light load, same as the failed full)
hypothesis: netem dequeues on whichever CPU runs the qdisc; veth hands each frame to that CPU's receive backlog, so consecutive frames handed to different CPUs can be processed out of order
supports_if: every frame overtaken at the receiver socket is overtaken by a frame handed to a different CPU, and processing order equals socket order
refutes_if: an overtaken frame and its overtaker were handed to the same CPU, or the traced processing order is in egress order while the socket order is not
policy: executed once; outcome retained whether or not reordering recurs; tracing perturbs timing and its absence would not refute the failed full
